case_title: Dattatraya v. The State of Maharashtra
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 302 and 316 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment and 10 years of R.I. respectively
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder under Section 304 Part II IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, a married man, engaged in a fight with his wife while she was cooking food in the kitchen. During the altercation, the accused poured kerosene on her and set her on fire, resulting in severe burn injuries. The victim sustained 98% burn injuries and later died. The victim also gave birth to a stillborn child the following day. A dying declaration was recorded by the victim, which stated that the accused had poured kerosene on her and set her on fire. The accused's maternal grandmother and maternal aunt, who were present at the scene, witnessed the incident and corroborated the victim's account. The accused was initially charged under Sections 302 and 316 of the IPC. The prosecution presented medical reports, the dying declaration, and witness testimonies to establish the incident.
